name: mean-reversion-bot
description: Mean Reversion Trading Bot with proper timing - Slowdown leads, RSI confirms/exits

scripts.stats: node -e "const Config = require('./config/Config'); const TradeLogger = require('./services/TradeLogger'); const config = new Config(); const logger = new TradeLogger(config); console.log(JSON.stringify(logger.getStats(), null, 2))"
scripts.trades: node -e "const Config = require('./config/Config'); const TradeLogger = require('./services/TradeLogger'); const config = new Config(); const logger = new TradeLogger(config); console.log(logger.getTrades(10))"
scripts.no-trades: node -e "const Config = require('./config/Config'); const NoTradeLogger = require('./services/NoTradeLogger'); const config = new Config(); const logger = new NoTradeLogger(config); console.log(logger.getNoTrades(10))"
